method.execution: Modal CPU; no GPU predictions, no new MSAs
method.center: Observed homologous KRAS G12 Cα when present. Missing/empty sites transferred through HLA groove Cα alignment; explicitly labelled.
method.frame: Orthographic projection in 7OW6 peptide N→C x-axis / outward HLA groove normal z-axis. HLA first180 residues aligned by sequence and iteratively trimmed Kabsch (3Å;≥80pairs). Right-handed frame; original coordinates unchanged.
method.contact: Partner protein residue with any original heavy atom ≤4.5Å from HLA/β2m/peptide, including explicitly covalently attached target nonpolymers (validated deposited bonds≤2.8Å), even if their author chain IDs overlap a binder. Waters/unbound solvent excluded. Peptide-only and P6 contacts use actual available peptide atoms; absent values are null.
method.shape: Partner solvent-accessible surface buried by target: Shrake–Rupley 256points/atom; Bondi radii +1.4Å probe. Per-residue projected convex envelope with original z depth; 2D projection is not area-preserving or geodesic.
method.electrostatics: Isolated full partner in saved bound conformation; PDB2PQR AMBER / PROPKA pH7; APBS LPBE at298.15K,150mM monovalent salt,εprotein2,εwater78.54.129³ fine96Å grid,0.75Å spacing. Potential kT/e sampled at original partner buried SAS points. Heavy atom additions in PQR preparation do not change displayed coordinates. Failed calculations remain unavailable.
method.hydrophobicity: Kyte–Doolittle values for each contacting partner amino acid. Residue chemistry, not a solvent-dependent free energy calculation.
method.size: Modeled side-chain heavy-atom vdW union volume on0.4Åvoxel grid; excludes N,CA,C,O,OXT and hydrogens. Not empirical partial molar residue volume.
method.target_covalent_ligands: Explicit target-linked nonprotein residues contribute contact geometry and buried surface. Peptide-only and mutation-site distances retain polymer-residue atoms, excluding separately named ligands. Partner APBS describes protein chains only.
